sentences.en: She looked at me with a passionate expression of entreaty.
sentences.zh: 她用充满激情的表情恳求地看着我。

sentences.en: I like such a passionate picture as Gogh painted.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢梵高的那些热情奔放的画作。

sentences.en: So passionate was his letter that she was moved to tears.
sentences.zh: 他的信如此充满激情，以至于让她感动得流下了眼泪。

senses.zh: 多情的 - 表现[充满]激情的，激昂的 - 热切的；强烈的

mnemonic: 词根记忆：passion（激情）+ate（具有…的）→充满激情的
